notes: This contract pins one bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 completed-model composition rule: every supplied object-class hierarchy must be rooted at HLAobjectRoot and every supplied interaction-class hierarchy must be rooted at HLAinteractionRoot. The current focused case verifies standard roots are supplied when those tables omit them and leaves an omitted objects or interactions table representable for an incomplete DIF module; it does not verify rejection of a nonstandard top-level class. This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance or public-service evidence claim.
